basic_info.description: Nestled between two of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoodsNoe Valley and the vibrant Mission Districtthis stunning top-floor three-bedroom, two-bath home blends the architectural charm of the Victorian era with modern updates. High ceilings, abundant natural light, and elegant period details create a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a stylish en-suite primary bedroom with a beautifully updated bathroom, while a second bathroom has been tastefully renovated with quality finishes. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances, elegant cabinetry, abundant storage, and an in-unit washer and dryer for ultimate convenience. The bright front room is framed by classic bay windows, filling the space with natural light. A versatile third bedroom offers the perfect space for guests and a home office. Additional highlights include side-by-side parking and extra deeded storage. Situated on a quiet street yet just moments from the best of city living, you'll enjoy easy access to the Noe Valley Farmers Market, Valencia Corridor's renowned shops and restaurants, lively Mission nightlife, and major tech shuttles. A perfect blend of timeless elegance and modern comfortthis is a wonderful place to call home!
